definition_en: a strong feeling of dislike or repugnance toward something
core_image: 一闻到那气味，整个人就往后缩
scene: 她还没进门就捂住了鼻子。She has an aversion to the smell of fresh paint.
sceneCN: 这里 aversion 指「厌恶、反感」（第 1 个义项：强烈的不喜欢）；句意：她一闻到新油漆的气味就本能地反感。

derivatives.zh: 厌恶的；不愿的（aversion 的形容词基础）
令人反感的；引发回避的（aversion + -ive）

senses.title: A strong feeling of dislike
senses.definition: an intense and settled feeling of dislike toward a thing, act, or person
senses.definitionCN: 对某物、某行为或某人的强烈而稳固的厌恶感
senses.example: His aversion to crowds kept him out of stadiums.
senses.exampleCN: 他对人群的厌恶让他从不进体育场。
senses.why: The root means turned away: the feeling that pivots you from a thing.
senses.whyCN: 词根义为「转开」：那种把你从某物前转走的情绪。

senses.title: The object of dislike
senses.definition: the thing or person one feels aversion toward
senses.definitionCN: 引发或承受厌恶的具体对象
senses.exampleCN: 人群成了他最憎恶的东西。
senses.why: The feeling names what it points at, as loves and hates both do.
senses.whyCN: 情绪会转而指称其对象，爱与恨皆然。

senses.title: Reluctance or unwillingness
senses.definition: a disinclination to do something, milder than disgust
senses.definitionCN: 对做某事的不情愿，弱于憎恶
senses.example: She felt an aversion to signing the contract so soon.
senses.exampleCN: 她不愿这么快就签下合同。
senses.why: The turning away can be small: a hesitation rather than a recoil.
senses.whyCN: 「转开」可以很小：只是迟疑，而非后缩。

senses.title: Risk aversion in economics
senses.definition: the preference for certain outcomes over gambles of equal expected value
senses.definitionCN: 在期望值相同的情况下宁取确定结果的偏好
senses.example: Risk aversion explains why insurers stay in business.
senses.exampleCN: 风险厌恶解释了保险业长盛的原因。
senses.why: Decision theory borrowed the feeling-word for a measurable preference.
senses.whyCN: 决策理论借情绪词命名一种可测量的偏好。

senses.title: Conditioned avoidance in psychology
senses.definition: learned avoidance of a stimulus paired with discomfort
senses.definitionCN: 因刺激伴随不适而习得的回避反应
senses.example: Taste aversion stopped the wolves from baited traps.
senses.exampleCN: 味觉厌恶让狼群不再碰下了药的陷阱。
senses.why: One bad pairing is enough; the body remembers the turning away.
senses.whyCN: 一次糟糕的配对就足够；身体记住了那一次转开。

senses.title: Aversion therapy
senses.definition: treatment that pairs an unwanted behavior with unpleasant stimuli
senses.definitionCN: 把不良行为与不快刺激配对的治疗方法
senses.example: Aversion therapy once paired smoking with mild shocks.
senses.exampleCN: 厌恶疗法曾把吸烟与轻微电击配对。
senses.why: Clinics trained the turning away on purpose.
senses.whyCN: 临床上有意训练这种「转开」反应。

senses.title: Moral repugnance
senses.definition: revulsion at cruelty, injustice, or corruption on principle
senses.definitionCN: 出于原则对残暴、不公或腐败的憎恶
senses.example: His aversion to cruelty drove him into law.
senses.exampleCN: 他对残暴的深恶痛绝驱使他投身法律。
senses.why: When the turning away is principled, it becomes a stance.
senses.whyCN: 当「转开」出于原则，它就成了一种立场。

senses.title: Instinctive physical recoil
senses.definition: an automatic bodily recoil at smells, textures, or sights
senses.definitionCN: 对气味、质感或画面不假思索的身体后退
senses.example: A visceral aversion made her drop the spoon.
senses.exampleCN: 本能的排斥让她丢下了勺子。
senses.why: This is the root at its most literal: the spine itself turns.
senses.whyCN: 这是词根最字面的呈现：连脊椎都在转开。

intro.en: Aversion comes from Latin aversio, a turning away, from avertere, from ab, away, plus vertere, to turn; English took both the noun and its adjective averse from the same participle.
intro.cn: aversion 出自拉丁语 aversio「转开」，源于 avertere，由 ab（离开）+ vertere（转）构成；英语的名词 aversion 与形容词 averse 同出一源。

items.en: The turn-root is the reconstructed wer-, to bend or turn.
items.cn: 「转」的词根出自重构词干 wer-「弯、转」。

items.en: averted combined ab, away, with vertere, to turn.
items.cn: 拉丁语 avertere 组合 ab「离开」与 vertere「转」。

items.en: aversio named the act or state of turning away, soon in moral contexts.
items.cn: aversio 指转开的动作或状态，很快用于道德语境。

items.en: Old and Middle French carried aversion with the psychological sense.
items.cn: 古法语与中古法语以 aversion 承载心理义项。

items.en: English adopted aversion around 1600, first of mental turning from objects of dislike.
items.cn: 英语约在 1600 年前后借入 aversion，先指心理上对所憎之物的背离。

items.en: Economics added risk aversion, and psychology added conditioned aversion.
items.cn: 经济学加入「风险厌恶」，心理学加入「条件性厌恶」。

note.en: Group one gathers the turning family and a spelling trap; group two gathers words of strong dislike.
note.cn: 第一组收「转」词族及拼写陷阱；第二组收强烈厌恶义场的词。

entries.definition: a rare, obsolete word for turning toward; one letter from aversion.
entries.definitionCN: 罕见的废词，义为「转向」；与 aversion 仅差一个字母。

entries.definition: the Late Latin source noun, a turning away.
entries.definitionCN: 晚期拉丁语源头名词，义为「转开」。

entries.definition: the verb of the family: to turn away or prevent.
entries.definitionCN: 词族中的动词：转开、防止。

entries.definition: strong, often moral, dislike; more formal than aversion.
entries.definitionCN: 强烈且常带道德色彩的憎恶；比 aversion 更正式。

entries.definition: sudden and violent disgust; aversion at its most physical.
entries.definitionCN: 突发而剧烈的恶心感；aversion 最生理性的一面。

entries.definition: mild dislike; the polite end of the scale.
entries.definitionCN: 轻微的不喜欢；厌恶刻度上温和的一端。

entries.definition: settled, intense hatred; beyond mere aversion.
entries.definitionCN: 根深蒂固的憎恨；超出单纯的厌恶。
不带情绪温度的不情愿。

normalIntro.en: Keep the family visible: avert, averse, aversion are one turning in three grammars.
normalIntro.cn: 看清词族：avert、averse、aversion 是同一个「转」的三种语法形态。

normal.en: av- from ab- means away; -sion makes the turning a noun.
normal.cn: av- 出自 ab-「离开」；-sion 把「转」变成名词。

normal.en: have an aversion to is the standard pattern; note the preposition to.
normal.cn: 固定句型 have an aversion to，注意介词用 to。

normal.en: risk aversion is the economics term every exam loves.
normal.cn: risk aversion 是考试偏爱的经济学术语：风险厌恶。

normal.en: aversion therapy is the clinical collocation.
normal.cn: aversion therapy 是临床搭配：厌恶疗法。

normal.en: Plural aversions lists your several dislikes.
normal.cn: 复数 aversions 可列举多种厌恶。

abstract.en: Feel the whole body step back one measured pace.
abstract.cn: 感觉整个人向后退了整整齐齐的一步。

abstract.en: Aversion is a door your mind shuts before thinking.
abstract.cn: aversion 是理智开口之前心先关上的门。

abstract.en: Picture the compass needle refusing a direction it once held.
abstract.cn: 想象罗盘针拒绝它曾指向的方向。

examples.en: He confessed an aversion to loud music of any era.
examples.cn: 他坦承对任何年代的吵闹音乐都很反感。

examples.en: Her aversions ran from cilantro to committee meetings.
examples.cn: 她的厌恶清单从香菜一路排到委员会会议。

examples.en: Investors' risk aversion rose sharply after the crash.
examples.cn: 崩盘后投资者的风险厌恶急剧上升。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「恶我神」——那味道一飘来就「恶我神」，魂儿都厌恶得缩回去了

root: 出自晚期拉丁语 aversio「转开」，为 avertere（ab- 离开 + vertere 转）的名词化形式，与 avert、averse 同族；约 1600 年经法语进入英语，先表心理背离，近现代被经济学与心理学借作术语。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow the turning away: the feeling, its object, plain reluctance, and the technical senses that economics and psychology built on it.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项顺着「转开」展开：情绪本身、情绪对象、单纯的不情愿，以及经济学与心理学在此之上建立的技术义项。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the whole body stepping back before the mind explains why.
core.cn: 核心意象：理智还没解释，身体已先退后一步。

branches.en: THE FEELING SIDE: the dislike and the thing it points at.
branches.cn: 情感一面：厌恶本身与它指向的对象。

branches.en: THE WILLINGNESS SIDE: mild, everyday reluctance.
branches.cn: 意愿一面：日常而轻微的不情愿。

branches.en: THE ECONOMIC SIDE: measured risk aversion.
branches.cn: 经济一面：可度量的风险厌恶。

branches.en: THE CLINICAL SIDE: conditioned and therapeutic avoidance.
branches.cn: 临床一面：条件性回避与厌恶疗法。

branches.en: THE DEEP SIDE: moral principle and bodily recoil.
branches.cn: 深层一面：道德原则与生理排斥。

intro.en: Aversion is the participle aversus plus the noun ending -io: a turning, made into a thing.
intro.cn: aversion 由分词 aversus 加名词词尾 -io 构成：把「转开」变成一个事物。

latinIntro.en: Latin made -tio nouns from participles, and French -tion passed them into English by the hundred.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语用 -tio 由分词造名词，法语 -tion 又把成百上千个这样的词送进英语。
